* Nested definitions

** Description group

- Summary :: A description before the nested items.
- Details ::
  - =Nested literal item.=
  - Nested ordinary item.
- Explanation :: A description after the nested items.

Paragraph after the description list.

** Continued descriptions

+ Continuation ::
  Description starting on the following line.
+ Empty ::
+ Next :: Description following an empty entry.
